lines.text: The people reached Kadesh-barnea, and twelve men, one from each tribe, were selected to search out the land.
The spies came to the Valley of Eshcol and carried some of the land's fruit down to the people.
The LORD said none of that generation would see the land sworn to their fathers, except Caleb son of Nun.
The LORD told them to head toward the Dead Sea, but they said they would go up and fight.
The Amorites chased Israel like bees from Seir to Hormah, and the people then stayed in Kadesh a long time.
